parts.title: What the Big Bang Theory Does and Does Not Claim
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: That the universe originated in a single, definable event — an image evoked by the phrase 'the Big Bang' — is, strictly speaking, a more contested characterization than popular accounts suggest. What cosmologists mean by the term is narrower and more hedged than the everyday image implies: a description, grounded in extrapolating well-tested physical laws backward in time, of how a hot, dense, rapidly expanding early universe evolved into the cosmos observed today, rather than a claim, fully substantiated by current physics, about what — if anything — preceded or caused that initial state.

Confidence in this picture rests on several independent lines of evidence rather than any single observation. Foremost, historically, was the discovery that distant galaxies recede from our own at speeds roughly proportional to their distance — a relationship first documented in the late 1920s and now understood to reflect space itself expanding, not galaxies moving through static space. Run the expansion backward mathematically, and one arrives, under reasonable assumptions, at an epoch when all observable matter would have been compressed into an extraordinarily hot, dense state.

It was not this recession data alone, however, but a largely accidental discovery decades later that most decisively corroborated the emerging picture. In 1965, researchers testing a radio antenna detected a faint, uniform background of microwave radiation arriving from every direction in the sky — radiation interpreted as the cooled remnant of light released roughly 380,000 years after the universe's earliest moments, once it had cooled enough for atoms to form and light to travel freely. Minor variations in this background's temperature are understood to trace the density fluctuations from which galaxies eventually formed, linking the earliest observable universe to the large-scale structure seen billions of years later.

A further, independently derived line of support comes from predictions about the relative abundance of the universe's lightest elements. Calculations describing nuclear reactions in the first few minutes after the hot early state predict specific ratios of hydrogen, helium, and trace lithium that should have formed before stars existed to synthesize heavier elements. Observed hydrogen and helium abundances match these predictions closely enough to count, in the view of most physicists, as strong evidence; the predicted lithium abundance, however, diverges from what telescopes observe by a margin researchers have neither dismissed as error nor fully explained — a discrepancy known, with evident understatement, as the 'lithium problem.'

Even granting this evidence, the standard picture left certain features of the observed universe — its large-scale uniformity and geometric flatness — without a clear explanation, prompting the proposal, in the early 1980s, of a still-earlier phase of extraordinarily rapid expansion known as cosmic inflation. Inflationary models account elegantly for these puzzling features and have gained support from measurements of the microwave background's fine structure; whether inflation occurred in the manner any single model proposes, however, remains genuinely unsettled, since multiple variants fit current data adequately and no observation yet favors one definitively.

Perhaps the most misunderstood aspect of the theory concerns what it claims about the very beginning. Extrapolating known laws backward far enough produces a mathematical singularity — a point of infinite density at which those equations cease to yield meaningful predictions. Whether this artifact corresponds to an actual physical event, a literal beginning of time, or merely marks a boundary beyond which physics stops applying and some unknown theory would describe what came before, is a question current cosmology cannot answer with confidence; physicists are, on this point, considerably more **circumspect** than the popular narrative of a single originating explosion suggests.

This acknowledged limitation has not stopped more speculative proposals from circulating, some better supported than others. A minority of theorists, extending inflationary models to their logical conclusion, have proposed that inflation might never fully end everywhere at once, generating not one universe but a continually branching multitude of separate regions — a scenario described as eternal inflation and popularly associated with a broader multiverse. Such proposals remain, by the admission of many who take them seriously, largely **unfalsifiable** given current observational capacity, and mainstream cosmology treats them as intriguing possibilities warranting further development rather than established components of the standard model.

Considered as a whole, the evidence supporting an early hot, dense, expanding universe is genuinely robust for describing cosmic evolution from a small fraction of a second after that state onward — robust enough that the framework is treated as settled science. What remains considerably less settled, and what popular treatments frequently elide, is any confident claim about what the singularity itself represents physically, or what — if a meaningful 'before' even applies — might have preceded it; on these deepest questions, most working cosmologists hold a position of disciplined uncertainty rather than confident narrative.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

questions.explanation: Sử dụng kỹ năng Skimming (Đọc lướt). Đọc đoạn 1 (thuyết Big Bang được giải thích như sự tiến hóa từ trạng thái sớm thay vì nguồn gốc điểm khởi đầu) kết hợp với đoạn cuối cùng (đoạn 8) để tổng hợp luận điểm chính của tác giả: có nhiều bằng chứng độc lập ủng hộ mô hình vũ trụ giãn nở sớm, nhưng nguồn gốc điểm khởi đầu (singularity) vẫn là một câu hỏi mở chưa có lời giải đáp chắc chắn.

questions.stem: What role did the cosmic microwave background play relative to the earlier redshift observations?

options.A: It directly contradicted conclusions cosmologists had drawn from earlier redshift observations
options.B: It first suggested cosmic expansion decades before redshift observations were ever made
options.C: It provided decisive corroboration for a picture the redshift data had already suggested
options.D: It was discovered specifically to test predictions made by redshift measurements

questions.explanation: quét từ khóa "cosmic microwave background", "redshift" ở đoạn 3. Đoạn văn chỉ ra sự phát hiện tình cờ của bức xạ nền vi sóng năm 1965 đã cung cấp bằng chứng củng cố mang tính quyết định (decisively corroborated) cho bức tranh giãn nở mà dữ liệu dịch chuyển đỏ (redshift) trước đó đã gợi mở.

questions.stem: According to the passage, how does the predicted abundance of lithium compare to that of hydrogen and helium in relation to observation?

options.A: Lithium predictions match observation perfectly while hydrogen and helium predictions remain disputed
options.B: All three predicted element abundances match observed values equally closely and without exception
options.C: None of the three predicted element abundances have ever matched any observed values
options.D: Hydrogen and helium predictions match observation closely, but the lithium prediction remains unexplained

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned in connection with the theory of cosmic inflation?

options.A: Receiving support from background fine structure
options.B: Helping explain the universe's large-scale uniformity
options.C: Helping explain the universe's geometric flatness
options.D: Being confirmed by direct gravitational detection

questions.explanation: Đọc quét đoạn 5 về thuyết lạm phát vũ trụ (cosmic inflation). Các yếu tố được nhắc tới bao gồm: nhận được sự ủng hộ từ cấu trúc vi mô của bức xạ nền (background fine structure), giúp giải thích tính đồng nhất diện rộng (large-scale uniformity) và độ phẳng hình học (geometric flatness). Tìm phương án đề cập đến chi tiết không hề xuất hiện trong bài (như việc được xác nhận trực tiếp bằng dò tìm sóng hấp dẫn).

questions.stem: The word "circumspect" in paragraph 6 is closest in meaning to _______.

options.B: certain
options.C: circular
options.D: singular

questions.explanation: từ "circumspect" ở đoạn 6 mô tả thái độ của các nhà vật lý so với truyền thông đại chúng: họ cẩn trọng hơn, không khẳng định chắc chắn về điểm khởi đầu khi chưa đủ dữ liệu. Từ này đồng nghĩa với cẩn trọng, thận trọng (cautious).

questions.explanation: từ "unfalsifiable" ở đoạn 7 mô tả các lý thuyết lạm phát vĩnh cửu và đa vũ trụ chưa thể bác bỏ hay kiểm chứng được bằng năng lực quan sát hiện tại. Từ này đồng nghĩa với không thể kiểm chứng/bác bỏ (untestable).

questions.stem: The phrase "This acknowledged limitation" in paragraph 7 refers to _______.

options.A: the accidental discovery of background radiation described earlier
options.B: cosmology's inability to explain what preceded the singularity
options.C: the earlier discrepancy in predicted lithium abundance levels

Áp dụng quy tắc đọc ngược lại đoạn 6 phía trước: câu trước thảo luận về giới hạn của vật lý hiện đại khi không thể giải thích chắc chắn điều gì đứng đằng sau điểm kỳ dị hay điều gì xảy ra trước đó. questions.stem: Which best characterizes what current cosmology can confidently claim about the universe's ultimate origin?

options.A: It can confirm that the singularity represents a literal physical beginning
options.B: It can confirm with full certainty that nothing existed before the singularity
options.C: It can describe the early dense state, but cannot confirm what preceded it
options.D: It can rule out entirely any earlier physical process preceding the singularity

questions.stem: What can be inferred from paragraph 5 about the current scientific status of cosmic inflation?

options.A: It was proposed but has since contradicted all microwave background measurements
options.B: It is widely supported as a concept, but its precise mechanism remains unsettled
options.C: It has been fully confirmed in every detail by unanimous scientific agreement
options.D: It has been entirely rejected due to a lack of supporting evidence

questions.explanation: Đọc đoạn 5 về thuyết lạm phát vũ trụ. Tác giả nêu rõ khái niệm lạm phát giải thích tốt các đặc tính của vũ trụ và có nhiều bằng chứng ủng hộ, tuy nhiên mô hình chính xác diễn ra như thế nào vẫn chưa được chốt (unsettled) vì có nhiều biến thể cùng phù hợp với dữ liệu hiện tại. Từ đó suy luận rằng khái niệm này được ủng hộ rộng rãi nhưng cơ chế chính xác vẫn chưa được quyết định chắc chắn.

questions.stem: What is the author's overall attitude toward popular narratives describing the Big Bang as a single, fully explained originating explosion?

options.A: Skeptical of oversimplified certainty, favoring a carefully qualified account of current physics
options.B: Dismissive of all scientific evidence supporting an early expanding universe
options.C: Fully supportive, treating popular narratives as accurate and complete summaries of physics
options.D: Indifferent, expressing no view on how the theory is presented

questions.explanation: Xem xét giọng văn ở đoạn 1 và đoạn 8 khi tác giả đối sánh giữa truyền thông đại chúng (popular narrative) vốn đơn giản hóa Big Bang như một vụ nổ đơn lẻ với thực tế nghiên cứu vật lý. Giọng văn tác giả thể hiện sự hoài nghi trước những khẳng định đơn giản hóa thái quá và ủng hộ cách tiếp cận có điều kiện, cẩn trọng của vật lý hiện đại.

parts.title: Meditation and Yoga: Ancient Practices in the Modern World
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: Meditation and yoga trace their roots back thousands of years to ancient India, where **they** developed as parts of a broader spiritual and philosophical tradition. Early practitioners believed that training the mind through quiet reflection could lead to a calm, settled state, while physical postures were designed to prepare the body for long periods of stillness. Over centuries, these two practices became closely linked, each reinforcing benefits associated with the other. Many of the earliest written descriptions of yogic postures and breathing techniques appear in religious texts that also emphasize ethical conduct and self-discipline.

In recent decades, meditation and yoga have spread far beyond their original cultural setting and are now practiced by millions of people around the world. Gyms, community centers, and even workplaces offer regular classes, and mobile applications allow beginners to follow guided sessions from home. Some people are drawn to yoga mainly for its physical benefits, such as improved flexibility and muscle strength, while others focus on the mental side, using meditation to manage everyday stress. Choosing the right style often takes some trial and error. Several distinct styles have emerged, ranging from gentle, slow-paced sessions suitable for older adults to **vigorous** forms that resemble a full workout.

A growing body of scientific research has examined how these practices affect the body and mind. Several studies have found that regular meditation can lower levels of cortisol, a hormone closely linked to stress, and may also help reduce blood pressure over time. Researchers have also reported improvements in sleep quality among people who meditate consistently for several weeks. Most experts agree, however, that the benefits tend to appear **gradually** rather than immediately, and that short, irregular sessions produce far weaker results than a steady, ongoing routine. Some findings remain limited by small sample sizes, so scientists continue to call for larger, longer-term studies.

For beginners, both meditation and yoga are relatively easy to start, since neither requires special equipment beyond a comfortable mat or cushion. Many instructors recommend starting with short sessions, perhaps ten minutes a day, before gradually increasing the duration as the body and mind adjust. People with existing health conditions, particularly joint or back problems, are usually advised to consult a doctor or an experienced instructor before attempting more demanding postures. With patience and regular practice, most people find that these ancient techniques offer a simple, accessible way to support both physical and mental well-being.

questions.stem: According to the passage, what did early practitioners believe training the mind could achieve?

options.A: Better results only when combined with strict dietary rules
options.B: The complete elimination of any need for physical practice
options.C: A calm, settled state supported by physical stillness
options.D: Improved memory mainly for use in religious ceremonies

questions.explanation: quét từ khóa "early practitioners", "training the mind" ở đoạn 1. Tìm thông tin về niềm tin của những người thực hành thời kỳ đầu: việc rèn luyện tâm trí giúp đạt trạng thái tĩnh lặng, bình thản nhờ sự trợ giúp của việc giữ yên cơ thể (physical stillness).

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: Yoga without meditation is far more effective for serious health conditions
options.B: Scientific research proves meditation is the single best remedy for stress
options.C: Meditation and yoga spread globally and remain accessible to beginners
options.D: Meditation and yoga are difficult techniques best suited for experts

questions.explanation: Sử dụng kỹ năng Skimming (Đọc lướt). Đọc đoạn 1 (nguồn gốc và sự phát triển toàn cầu của thiền & yoga) kết hợp với các đoạn tiếp theo (lợi ích sức khỏe, tính dễ tiếp cận cho người mới bắt đầu) và đoạn cuối. Lựa chọn phương án bao quát bức tranh tổng thể: thiền và yoga đã lan rộng ra toàn cầu và hoàn toàn phù hợp, dễ tiếp cận cho cả người mới bắt đầu.

questions.stem: The word "vigorous" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to _______.

options.A: vigilant
options.B: energetic
options.C: peaceful
options.D: traditional

questions.explanation: từ "vigorous" ở đoạn 2 mô tả các hình thức tập luyện đòi hỏi nhiều năng lượng, cường độ cao trái ngược với tư thế tĩnh. Do đó, từ này đồng nghĩa với giàu năng lượng, mạnh mẽ (energetic).

questions.stem: According to the passage, what did researchers report about people who meditate consistently for several weeks?

options.A: Their sleep quality tended to improve
options.B: Their cortisol levels increased before dropping sharply
options.C: Their blood pressure rose noticeably at first
options.D: Their need for physical exercise disappeared completely

questions.explanation: quét từ khóa "several weeks", "consistently" ở đoạn 3. Đoạn văn nêu rõ những người kiên trì thiền định trong nhiều tuần có sự cải thiện rõ rệt về chất lượng giấc ngủ (sleep quality).

questions.stem: The word "they" in paragraph 1 refers to _______.

options.A: ancient religious texts
options.B: meditation and yoga
options.C: physical postures
options.D: early practitioners

questions.explanation: Tìm đại từ "they" ở đoạn 1. Áp dụng quy tắc đọc ngược lại câu phía trước để xác định danh từ số nhiều được thay thế: câu trước giới thiệu về thiền và yoga (meditation and yoga) như hai phương pháp rèn luyện tâm - thân lâu đời. Đại từ này quy chiếu trực tiếp đến thiền và yoga.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of regular meditation?

options.A: Improved quality of sleep
options.B: Lower levels of a stress-related hormone
options.C: Reduced blood pressure over time
options.D: Reduced risk of developing joint or back injuries

questions.explanation: Đọc quét đoạn 3 để kiểm tra danh sách các lợi ích của thiền được liệt kê: giảm mức hormone căng thẳng (cortisol), hạ huyết áp (blood pressure) và cải thiện giấc ngủ (sleep quality). Phương án đề cập đến việc giảm nguy cơ chấn thương khớp hoặc lưng là chi tiết không hề được đề cập làm lợi ích trực tiếp của thiền.

questions.stem: The word "gradually" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to _______.

options.A: immediately
options.B: gratefully
options.C: slowly
options.D: rarely

questions.explanation: từ "gradually" ở đoạn 3 mô tả quá trình các lợi ích sức khỏe xuất hiện một cách từng bước, từ từ qua thời gian rèn luyện. Từ này sát nghĩa nhất với chậm rãi, từ từ (slowly).

questions.stem: What can be inferred about people who only practice meditation for short, irregular sessions?

options.A: Their blood pressure will rise as a direct result of the irregular sessions
options.B: They should switch entirely to yoga instead of meditation
options.C: They are likely to see much weaker results than those with a steady routine
options.D: They will still experience the exact same benefits as regular practitioners

questions.explanation: Kết hợp thông tin ở đoạn 3 về tầm quan trọng của việc duy trì thói quen tập luyện đều đặn (steady routine) để đạt hiệu quả tối ưu. Từ đó suy luận rằng những người chỉ tập thiền ngắn hạn hoặc không đều đặn sẽ nhận được kết quả yếu hơn/ít hơn nhiều so với người tập luyện kiên trì.

questions.stem: According to the last paragraph, who is specifically advised to consult a doctor before attempting demanding yoga postures?

options.A: People who attend workplace wellness classes
options.B: People who have practiced yoga for over a year
options.C: People who prefer meditation over physical exercise
options.D: People with existing joint or back problems

questions.explanation: quét các từ khóa "consult a doctor", "demanding yoga postures" ở đoạn cuối cùng. Nhận diện đối tượng được khuyên nên tham khảo ý kiến bác sĩ: những người đang có các vấn đề về khớp hoặc lưng (existing joint or back problems).

questions.stem: What is the author's overall attitude toward meditation and yoga?

options.A: Strongly critical of yoga practice while favoring meditation techniques
options.B: Entirely neutral without expressing any personal view on the topic
options.C: Openly skeptical about the overall health benefits of both practices
options.D: Cautiously positive, noting real benefits along with patience Reading

questions.explanation: Phân tích sắc thái ngôn từ toàn bài: tác giả ghi nhận những lợi ích sức khỏe thực tế đã được khoa học chứng minh của thiền và yoga, nhưng đồng thời lưu ý người tập cần có sự kiên nhẫn và cẩn trọng đối với các bài tập thể chất nặng. Thái độ này thể hiện sự ủng hộ có cẩn trọng (cautiously positive). Lời khuyên: Hãy ưu tiên giải quyết nhanh các câu hỏi Quy chiếu (R1Q5) và Từ vựng (R1Q3, R1Q7). Tiếp theo, tận dụng kỹ năng đọc quét định vị từ khóa để hoàn thành nhóm câu Chi tiết (R1Q1, R1Q4, R1Q9) và Loại trừ (R1Q6). Sau cùng, liên kết tư duy logic toàn bài để chọn đáp án cho các câu hỏi tổng hợp gồm Suy luận (R1Q8), Thái độ tác giả (R1Q10) và Ý chính toàn bài (R1Q2).

parts.tips_md:
Để đạt kết quả tốt cho phần thi này, bạn nên áp dụng các chiến thuật sau đây:
- **Dạng câu hỏi Ý chính (R1Q2):** Sử dụng kỹ năng **Skimming** (Đọc lướt). Đọc đoạn 1 (nguồn gốc và sự phát triển toàn cầu của thiền & yoga) kết hợp với các đoạn tiếp theo (lợi ích sức khỏe, tính dễ tiếp cận cho người mới bắt đầu) và đoạn cuối. Lựa chọn phương án bao quát bức tranh tổng thể: thiền và yoga đã lan rộng ra toàn cầu và hoàn toàn phù hợp, dễ tiếp cận cho cả người mới bắt đầu.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Chi tiết (R1Q1, R1Q4 & R1Q9):** Sử dụng kỹ năng **Scanning** (Đọc quét từ khóa đặc hiệu):
  - Với **R1Q1**, quét từ khóa "early practitioners", "training the mind" ở đoạn 1. Tìm thông tin về niềm tin của những người thực hành thời kỳ đầu: việc rèn luyện tâm trí giúp đạt trạng thái tĩnh lặng, bình thản nhờ sự trợ giúp của việc giữ yên cơ thể (physical stillness).
  - Với **R1Q4**, quét từ khóa "several weeks", "consistently" ở đoạn 3. Đoạn văn nêu rõ những người kiên trì thiền định trong nhiều tuần có sự cải thiện rõ rệt về chất lượng giấc ngủ (sleep quality).
  - Với **R1Q9**, quét các từ khóa "consult a doctor", "demanding yoga postures" ở đoạn cuối cùng. Nhận diện đối tượng được khuyên nên tham khảo ý kiến bác sĩ: những người đang có các vấn đề về khớp hoặc lưng (existing joint or back problems).
- **Dạng câu hỏi Loại trừ NOT (R1Q6):** Đọc quét đoạn 3 để kiểm tra danh sách các lợi ích của thiền được liệt kê: giảm mức hormone căng thẳng (cortisol), hạ huyết áp (blood pressure) và cải thiện giấc ngủ (sleep quality). Phương án đề cập đến việc giảm nguy cơ chấn thương khớp hoặc lưng là chi tiết không hề được đề cập làm lợi ích trực tiếp của thiền.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Từ vựng theo ngữ cảnh (R1Q3 - R1Q7):** Sử dụng kỹ năng **Context Clues** (Manh mối ngữ cảnh):
  - Với **R1Q3**, từ **"vigorous"** ở đoạn 2 mô tả các hình thức tập luyện đòi hỏi nhiều năng lượng, cường độ cao trái ngược với tư thế tĩnh. Do đó, từ này đồng nghĩa với giàu năng lượng, mạnh mẽ (energetic).
  - Với **R1Q7**, từ **"gradually"** ở đoạn 3 mô tả quá trình các lợi ích sức khỏe xuất hiện một cách từng bước, từ từ qua thời gian rèn luyện. Từ này sát nghĩa nhất với chậm rãi, từ từ (slowly).
- **Dạng câu hỏi Quy chiếu (R1Q5):** Tìm đại từ **"they"** ở đoạn 1. Áp dụng quy tắc đọc ngược lại câu phía trước để xác định danh từ số nhiều được thay thế: câu trước giới thiệu về thiền và yoga (meditation and yoga) như hai phương pháp rèn luyện tâm - thân lâu đời. Đại từ này quy chiếu trực tiếp đến thiền và yoga.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Suy luận (R1Q8):** Kết hợp thông tin ở đoạn 3 về tầm quan trọng của việc duy trì thói quen tập luyện đều đặn (steady routine) để đạt hiệu quả tối ưu. Từ đó suy luận rằng những người chỉ tập thiền ngắn hạn hoặc không đều đặn sẽ nhận được kết quả yếu hơn/ít hơn nhiều so với người tập luyện kiên trì.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Thái độ của tác giả (R1Q10):** Phân tích sắc thái ngôn từ toàn bài: tác giả ghi nhận những lợi ích sức khỏe thực tế đã được khoa học chứng minh của thiền và yoga, nhưng đồng thời lưu ý người tập cần có sự kiên nhẫn và cẩn trọng đối với các bài tập thể chất nặng. Thái độ này thể hiện sự ủng hộ có cẩn trọng (cautiously positive). Lời khuyên: Hãy ưu tiên giải quyết nhanh các câu hỏi Quy chiếu (R1Q5) và Từ vựng (R1Q3, R1Q7). Tiếp theo, tận dụng kỹ năng đọc quét định vị từ khóa để hoàn thành nhóm câu **Chi tiết** (R1Q1, R1Q4, R1Q9) và **Loại trừ** (R1Q6). Sau cùng, liên kết tư duy logic toàn bài để chọn đáp án cho các câu hỏi tổng hợp gồm **Suy luận** (R1Q8), **Thái độ tác giả** (R1Q10) và **Ý chính toàn bài** (R1Q2).

parts.title: The Dust Bowl: An Environmental Crisis in Texas
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: During the 1930s, large areas of Texas and neighboring states became the center of one of the most severe environmental disasters in American history. What later became known as the Dust Bowl was not simply the product of a prolonged drought; rather, it emerged from a combination of natural conditions and decades of farming practices that had stripped the region's native grasses from millions of acres of land. Those grasses, deeply rooted and well suited to the semi-arid climate, had long held the topsoil in place even during dry periods.

Once farmers replaced native grassland with wheat and other row crops, the soil lost the protection it had relied on for centuries. When a severe drought struck in the early 1930s, the exposed, loosened topsoil had nothing left to hold it down, and **it** was this vulnerability—more than the drought alone—that turned a difficult season into a lasting **catastrophe**. Powerful winds swept across the dry fields, lifting enormous clouds of dust that could darken the sky for hours and, in the worst storms, travel hundreds of miles before finally settling. Farming families in the Texas Panhandle watched crops fail season after season, while fine dust worked its way into homes, wells, and even the lungs of those who could not avoid breathing it.

The human toll of the disaster extended well beyond ruined harvests. Thousands of families, unable to earn a living from land that no longer produced reliable crops, eventually abandoned their farms altogether. Many made the difficult decision to migrate toward California and other western states in search of work, joining a much larger wave of displacement that reshaped rural communities across the southern Plains. Not every family left, however; some stayed and adapted their methods, while government relief programs offered temporary assistance to those struggling the most.

In response to the crisis, federal and state agencies introduced a range of new farming techniques intended to prevent a similar disaster from happening again. Contour plowing, shelterbelts of trees planted to break the wind, and crop rotation were all promoted as ways to keep soil in place. While these measures did not fully undo the damage already done, they gradually reduced the likelihood of dust storms on a similar scale and reshaped how farmers across the Plains approached the land for generations afterward. Many of the conservation principles introduced during this period continue to influence agricultural policy today, long after the immediate crisis subsided.

Historians studying the period generally agree that the Dust Bowl offers an early and **instructive** example of how human activity can intensify a naturally occurring environmental event. Although drought conditions would likely have caused hardship regardless of farming practices, the scale and duration of the disaster owed a great deal to choices made well before the drought began. This lesson, some argue, remains relevant to environmental policy debates that continue in the present day.

questions.stem: According to the passage, what role did native grasses play before farming expanded in the region?

options.A: They were deliberately planted by early wheat farmers
options.B: They kept the topsoil in place even during dry periods
options.C: They were mainly valued as feed for livestock
options.D: They prevented any drought from occurring in the region

questions.explanation: quét các từ khóa "native grasses", "before farming" ở đoạn 1. Đoạn văn mô tả vai trò của cỏ bản địa là giữ cho lớp đất mặt cố định ngay cả trong những thời kỳ khô hạn (held the topsoil in place even during dry periods).

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: The Dust Bowl stemmed from drought and farming choices, driving major changes
options.B: Government relief programs served as the primary factor ending the crisis
options.C: Farmers in Texas strongly opposed every modern conservation technique introduced
options.D: The widespread disaster resulted strictly from severe natural drought conditions alone

questions.explanation: Sử dụng kỹ năng Skimming (Đọc lướt). Đọc câu đầu tiên của đoạn 1 (thảm họa Dust Bowl) kết hợp với câu chủ đề của đoạn 2 (sự kết hợp giữa hạn hán và kỹ thuật canh tác) và đoạn 5 (bài học lịch sử cho chính sách). Lựa chọn phương án bao quát bức tranh tổng thể: Dust Bowl bắt nguồn từ sự kết hợp giữa thiên tai hạn hán và các quyết định canh tác của con người, dẫn đến những thay đổi lớn trong nông nghiệp.

questions.stem: The word "catastrophe" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to _______.

options.A: category
options.B: improvement
options.C: disaster
options.D: controversy

questions.explanation: từ "catastrophe" ở đoạn 2 mô tả thảm họa môi trường nghiêm trọng do đợt hạn hán và đất bị xói mòn gây ra. Từ này đồng nghĩa với thảm họa, thiên tai (disaster).

questions.stem: According to the passage, what was the purpose of planting shelterbelts of trees?

options.A: To offer temporary housing for displaced farming families
options.B: To provide additional farmland once wheat crops had failed
options.C: To replace the need for contour plowing entirely
options.D: To break the force of the wind and help keep soil in place

questions.explanation: quét từ khóa "shelterbelts of trees" ở đoạn 4. Tìm lý do việc trồng các dải cây chắn gió được áp dụng: nhằm cản lực gió (break the wind) và giữ đất ở nguyên vị trí.

questions.stem: The word "it" in paragraph 2 refers to _______.

options.A: the wheat crop
options.B: the severe drought
options.C: the Texas Panhandle
options.D: the exposed, loosened topsoil's vulnerability

questions.explanation: Tìm đại từ "it" trong cấu trúc nhấn mạnh ở đoạn 2: "...and it was this vulnerability...". Áp dụng quy tắc đọc ngược lại vế trước để xác định thực thể tạo ra sự tổn thương: tình trạng đất mặt bị phơi ra và tơi xốp do mất lớp cỏ bảo vệ. Đại từ này quy chiếu trực tiếp đến sự tổn thương của lớp đất mặt tơi xốp.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a response families had to the crisis?

options.A: Staying and adapting their farming methods
options.B: Filing formal lawsuits against the federal government
options.C: Migrating toward California and other western states
options.D: Relying on government relief programs

questions.explanation: Đọc quét đoạn 3 để kiểm tra danh sách các phản ứng của người dân trước cuộc khủng hoảng: ở lại và thích nghi phương pháp mới (stayed and adapted), di cư sang các bang phía tây (migrate toward California), và dựa vào các chương trình cứu trợ của chính phủ (government relief programs). Tìm phương án chứa thông tin không hề xuất hiện trong bài (như việc đệ đơn kiện chính quyền liên bang).

questions.stem: The word "instructive" in paragraph 5 is closest in meaning to _______.

options.A: educational
options.B: controversial
options.C: destructive
options.D: instant

questions.explanation: từ "instructive" ở đoạn 5 mô tả sự kiện Dust Bowl là một ví dụ mang tính bài học/giáo dục sâu sắc cho các nhà hoạch định chính sách môi trường. Từ này sát nghĩa nhất với mang tính giáo dục, bài học (educational).

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the passage about the relationship between the drought and the scale of the Dust Bowl disaster?

options.A: The drought alone was fully responsible, regardless of any farming practices
options.B: Government relief programs were the main reason the drought became so severe
options.C: Farming decisions made before the drought significantly worsened its effects
options.D: The scale of the disaster had no connection to how the land had been farmed

questions.explanation: Đọc đoạn 5 về đánh giá của các nhà lịch sử. Tác giả nhấn mạnh rằng mặc dù hạn hán tự nhiên sẽ gây ra khó khăn, nhưng chính các quyết định canh tác từ trước đó đã làm trầm trọng thêm đáng kể quy mô và mức độ tàn phá của thảm họa. Tìm phương án phản ánh đúng mối quan hệ suy luận này.

questions.stem: According to the passage, what happened to many families who could no longer earn a living from their land?

options.A: They eventually abandoned their farms and migrated in search of work
options.B: They received guaranteed employment through new federal agencies
options.C: They switched permanently to raising livestock instead of crops
options.D: They were required by law to sell their land to the government

questions.explanation: quét các từ khóa "no longer earn a living", "abandoned" ở đoạn 3. Nhận diện số phận của nhiều gia đình: họ buộc phải rời bỏ trang trại và di cư về phía tây (California) để tìm kiếm việc làm.

questions.stem: What is the author's overall purpose in writing this passage?

options.A: To criticize local farming families directly for poor land management choices
options.B: To show how human actions combined with natural conditions created a disaster
options.C: To prove that federal conservation programs ultimately failed across affected regions
options.D: To recount personal survivor stories from families during the severe drought Reading

questions.explanation: Phân tích mục tiêu xuyên suốt bài viết: tác giả trình bày nguyên nhân lịch sử, hậu quả xã hội và các giải pháp nông nghiệp nhằm chứng minh cách tác động của con người kết hợp với điều kiện tự nhiên tạo nên một thảm họa môi trường. Chọn phương án miêu tả chính xác mục đích giải thích sự kết hợp này.

- **Dạng câu hỏi Mục đích của tác giả (R2Q10):** Phân tích mục tiêu xuyên suốt bài viết: tác giả trình bày nguyên nhân lịch sử, hậu quả xã hội và các giải pháp nông nghiệp nhằm chứng minh cách tác động của con người kết hợp với điều kiện tự nhiên tạo nên một thảm họa môi trường. Chọn phương án miêu tả chính xác mục đích giải thích sự kết hợp này.
Lời khuyên: Bắt đầu bài làm bằng việc xử lý nhanh các câu hỏi Quy chiếu (R2Q5) và Từ vựng (R2Q3, R2Q7). Kế tiếp, tận dụng kỹ năng đọc quét để hoàn thành nhóm câu hỏi **Chi tiết** (R2Q1, R2Q4, R2Q9) và **Loại trừ** (R2Q6). Sau cùng, xâu chuỗi logic thông tin để chọn đáp án cho các câu tổng hợp bao gồm **Suy luận** (R2Q8), **Mục đích tác giả** (R2Q10) và **Ý** chính toàn bài (R2Q2).

parts.title: The Uneven Landscape of American Retirement Savings
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: A worker who retires today at sixty-five with a median-sized nest egg is, statistically speaking, an outlier rather than a typical case. Surveys conducted over the past decade consistently show that nearly half of American households nearing retirement age hold less than fifty thousand dollars in dedicated retirement accounts, a figure that falls well short of what most financial planners consider sufficient to sustain even a modest standard of living for two or three decades. What complicates the picture further is that this shortfall is not evenly distributed; rather, it clusters sharply around income level, industry, and generation, producing a system in which comfortable retirement has become less a universal expectation and more a privilege tied to particular career paths.

Divide households into five income groups, and the **disparity** becomes stark: the top fifth holds roughly two-thirds of all retirement wealth in the country, while the bottom two-fifths combined hold barely five percent. This is not simply because wealthier households save a larger fraction of a similar income; higher earners are also more likely to work for employers who offer matching contributions, a benefit that can effectively double a worker's own savings rate over a career. Lower earners, by contrast, more frequently hold jobs — retail, food service, contract-based gig work — where no such matching exists, so even a disciplined saver among them accumulates far less by retirement age than an equally disciplined saver at a firm with a generous plan.

Generational data complicates a story that is sometimes told as simply "older generations saved more." Baby boomers, now mostly at or near retirement, do hold considerably more in retirement accounts on average than millennials did at the same age, adjusted for inflation — but boomers also benefited from an era of more widespread pension coverage, coverage that has sharply declined for younger workers even as wages have not kept pace with the cost of housing and education. It would therefore be misleading to attribute the generational savings gap purely to differences in financial discipline; structural shifts in how employers compensate workers explain a substantial share of the difference.

Employer-sponsored plans remain the primary savings vehicle for most Americans who save at all, yet participation is far from universal. Only around half of private-sector workers currently have access to any employer-sponsored retirement plan, and access itself varies enormously by firm size: large corporations overwhelmingly offer such plans, while small businesses, which employ a substantial share of the American workforce, frequently do not. The rapid growth of gig and contract work over the past fifteen years has widened this gap further, since independent contractors are, by definition, excluded from employer-sponsored benefits altogether and must rely entirely on personal initiative to save.

Race and ethnicity add another layer that income alone does not fully explain. Even among households with comparable earnings, Black and Hispanic families hold measurably less in retirement savings than white families, a gap researchers attribute to a combination of factors — lower rates of employer plan access in industries where these groups are overrepresented, less accumulated family wealth to draw on during financial emergencies, and, in some studies, longer average gaps in employment history. Some economists caution that **these figures** likely understate the true disparity, since survey-based wealth data tends to undercount households at the very bottom of the distribution.

In response to widening gaps, a number of states have introduced auto-enrollment retirement programs for workers whose employers do not offer a plan, automatically deducting a small percentage of pay into a state-managed account unless the worker actively opts out. Early results from these programs are promising: participation rates under auto-enrollment tend to run far higher than under systems requiring workers to sign up voluntarily, since default behavior turns out to matter enormously in retirement decisions. Whether these state-level programs can meaningfully close a gap built up over decades, however, remains to be seen, and several researchers note that a few percentage points of automatic savings cannot fully substitute for stable, well-paid employment with employer matching.

Projecting these trends forward carries real uncertainty. Some analysts argue that rising longevity, if it continues at recent rates, will only widen the gap between households that can comfortably self-fund thirty years of retirement and those that cannot, while others suggest that expanding auto-enrollment nationally, combined with possible reforms to Social Security, could narrow the disparity somewhat over the coming decades. What most researchers agree on, cautiously, is that the current trajectory — left unaddressed — points toward a retirement system that increasingly sorts Americans by the jobs they held decades earlier rather than by how carefully they managed their money.

questions.stem: According to the passage, why do higher earners tend to accumulate more retirement savings than lower earners with similar saving discipline?

options.A: They are legally required to contribute a larger fixed percentage of their income
options.B: They receive automatic government subsidies unavailable to lower-income workers
options.C: They typically retire several years later than lower-income workers do
options.D: They are more likely to work for employers offering matching contributions that boost their savings rate

questions.explanation: quét các từ khóa "higher earners", "accumulate more", "matching" ở đoạn 2. Nhận diện lý do người có thu nhập cao tích lũy nhiều hơn: họ dễ làm việc cho các chủ lao động có chính sách đóng góp tương ứng (matching contributions) giúp gia tăng tỷ lệ tiết kiệm.

questions.stem: The word "disparity" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to _______.

options.A: estimate
options.B: dispersal
options.C: consistency
options.D: imbalance

questions.explanation: từ "disparity" ở đoạn 2 mô tả sự chênh lệch lớn về tài sản hưu trí giữa nhóm 20% giàu nhất và nhóm 40% thấp nhất. Do đó, từ này đồng nghĩa với sự mất cân bằng, chênh lệch (imbalance).

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: Gig economy reliance serves as the sole factor driving systemic retirement shortfalls
options.B: Retirement savings reflect structural income and systemic gaps rather than individual discipline
options.C: State-level automatic enrolment schemes have effectively resolved nationwide retirement disparities
options.D: Older demographic groups consistently demonstrated superior financial discipline across their working careers

questions.explanation: Sử dụng kỹ năng Skimming (Đọc lướt). Đọc đoạn 1 (thực trạng thâm hụt tài khoản hưu trí không đồng đều) kết hợp với các đoạn tiếp theo về chênh lệch thu nhập, yếu tố thế hệ, sắc tộc và các chính sách can thiệp. Lựa chọn phương án bao quát bức tranh tổng thể: khoản tiết kiệm hưu trí phản ánh các rào cản mang tính cấu trúc về thu nhập và hệ thống hơn là kỷ luật cá nhân đơn thuần.

options.B: employer matching contribution percentages

questions.stem: What is one structural factor — beyond generational spending habits — that helps explain why millennials have saved less than boomers did at the same age?

options.A: Millennial workers remain largely unaware of basic tax-advantaged retirement accounts
options.B: Cultural preferences have shifted toward prioritizing immediate lifestyle and discretionary travel expenses
options.C: Pension coverage declined while wage growth lagged behind rising housing and education costs
options.D: Federal legislation reduced maximum annual contribution thresholds for private-sector retirement plans

options.A: They have already been proven to eliminate the racial and generational gaps described earlier in the passage

questions.stem: What is the author's overall attitude toward the future of the American retirement savings gap?

options.A: Optimistic, expecting existing administrative reforms to eliminate structural disparities rapidly
options.B: Cautiously concerned, highlighting troubling trends while acknowledging uncertainty
options.C: Dismissive, regarding systemic savings inequalities as insignificant policy concerns
options.D: Critical, placing primary responsibility on individual workers for poor long-term financial planning Reading

parts.title: Naming Practices Across Diasporas: A Comparative Look at Cambodian-American and Korean-American Names
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: Names do more than identify a person; they may also, some researchers argue, encode a family's negotiation with belonging, memory, and assimilation pressure, though the strength of that encoding appears to vary considerably depending on which diaspora community is examined. A study conducted by a researcher at the University of Toronto, drawing on several decades of naming records from two immigrant communities in North America, suggests that Cambodian-American and Korean-American families have arrived at strikingly different — and not always predictable — naming strategies since their respective waves of migration began in the twentieth century.

Korean-American naming patterns, the study found, have shifted in a fairly linear direction over successive generations: names that pair a Korean given name with an English middle name were common among children born to first-generation immigrant parents, whereas by the third generation, fully Anglicized given names — with a Korean name retained only as a private or ceremonial marker — had become the dominant pattern. This **trajectory**, the researcher notes, does not appear to reflect a rejection of heritage so much as a calculated response to workplace and school environments in which an unfamiliar given name was, anecdotally at least, associated with subtler forms of professional disadvantage.

Cambodian-American naming patterns, however — complicated by the community's arrival under very different historical circumstances, largely as refugees following the Cambodian genocide of the late 1970s rather than through the more voluntary migration pathways that shaped much of Korean immigration — did not follow this same linear Anglicization curve. Names in refugee-processing documentation were frequently altered, misspelled, or reordered by immigration officials unfamiliar with Khmer naming conventions, in which family names traditionally precede given names; this bureaucratic disruption, rather than any generational preference, accounts for a substantial share of the naming irregularities the researcher documented across Cambodian-American records, particularly among those who arrived as adults in the first wave.

What may be surprising is that later-generation Cambodian-American parents, rather than continuing toward fuller Anglicization as Korean-American families largely did, have in some documented cases reversed course, deliberately giving children traditional Khmer given names that their own immigrant parents had, under pressure or confusion, abandoned. The researcher is careful to note that this reversal should not be read as a uniform trend across the entire community — the available records suggest **it** characterizes a meaningful minority of families rather than the majority — but where it does occur, it appears concentrated among third-generation parents who did not personally experience the disruption of the refugee resettlement process firsthand.

[1] Several explanations for this divergence have been proposed, none of which the researcher treats as fully conclusive on its own. [2] One is that Korean immigration, occurring under comparatively more stable and voluntary conditions, allowed for a more gradual, less traumatic negotiation between heritage and assimilation, whereas Cambodian naming was shaped abruptly by crisis rather than by gradual family deliberation. **[3]** Another is that the Khmer-heritage reclamation observed in later generations may parallel broader patterns documented among other refugee-origin communities, in which a generation once removed from direct trauma feels more freedom to reconnect with practices their parents had, out of necessity, set aside. **[4]** A third, more tentative explanation holds that increased public visibility of Cambodian cultural heritage in recent decades may have reduced some of the professional stigma that once made Anglicization feel necessary, though the researcher stresses that this factor alone cannot account for the pattern's concentration among specifically third-generation families.

It would be a mistake, the researcher cautions, to treat either community's naming trajectory as representative of immigrant naming practices generally, since the historical circumstances of migration — whether voluntary or forced, gradual or abrupt — appear to shape naming outcomes as much as, or more than, generational distance from the country of origin does. Even within the Cambodian-American sample, families who arrived through later, more stable migration pathways showed naming patterns closer to the Korean-American trajectory than to those of refugee-era arrivals, a finding the researcher considers among the study's more significant contributions.

Taken together, these findings suggest that naming is not simply a passive marker of assimilation proceeding at a fixed generational pace, but rather an active, sometimes reversible negotiation shaped by the specific conditions under which a family's migration occurred. Whether this pattern would replicate among other diaspora communities with similarly divergent migration histories, the researcher acknowledges, remains an open question that would require comparative data this study did not attempt to gather.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: Korean-American families abandoned traditional names soon after arrival
options.B: Migration circumstances shape naming patterns more than generational distance alone
options.C: Bureaucratic errors fully account for naming changes across all communities

parts.tips_md:
Để đạt kết quả tốt cho phần thi này, bạn nên áp dụng các chiến thuật sau đây:
- **Dạng câu hỏi Ý chính (R4Q1):** Sử dụng kỹ năng **Skimming** (Đọc lướt). Đọc câu đầu tiên của đoạn 1 (tên gọi thể hiện thuộc tính văn hóa) kết hợp với nhận định xuyên suốt toàn bài so sánh giữa hai cộng đồng nhập cư: hoàn cảnh di cư (bối cảnh lịch sử, tự nguyện hay tị nạn) tác động mạnh mẽ đến quy luật đặt tên hơn là khoảng cách thế hệ đơn thuần.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Chi tiết (R4Q3 & R4Q7):** Sử dụng kỹ năng **Scanning** (Đọc quét từ khóa đặc hiệu):
  - Với **R4Q3**, quét các từ khóa "Korean-American", "Cambodian-American", "trajectories" ở đoạn 2 & 3. Đối sánh nguyên nhân: sự chuyển dịch của cộng đồng người Hàn mang tính tự nguyện/chủ động thích nghi với môi trường làm việc, trong khi sự thay đổi ở cộng đồng người Campuchia xuất phát từ những xáo trộn thủ tục hành chính khi tị nạn.
  - Với **R4Q7**, quét các từ khóa "significant findings", "later Cambodian immigrants" ở đoạn 5. Nhận diện phát hiện quan trọng của nhà nghiên cứu: các nhóm nhập cư Campuchia sau này (di cư tự nguyện) có xu hướng đặt tên tương tự như mô hình của người Mỹ gốc Hàn hơn là nhóm tị nạn giai đoạn đầu.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Loại trừ NOT (R4Q5):** Đọc quét đoạn 5 để kiểm tra các lý thuyết được đưa ra để giải thích cho sự đảo ngược (quay lại dùng tên Khmer truyền thống) ở thế hệ thứ ba: thế hệ trẻ cảm thấy tự do hơn khi kết nối lại với cội nguồn, sự gia tăng nhận diện văn hóa Campuchia giúp giảm định kiến xã hội. Tìm phương án đưa ra thông tin không hề xuất hiện trong bài (như một chính sách quốc gia khuyến khích khôi phục tên gốc).
- **Dạng câu hỏi Từ vựng theo ngữ cảnh (R4Q2 - R4Q6):** Sử dụng kỹ năng **Context Clues** (Manh mối ngữ cảnh):
  - Với **R4Q2**, từ **"trajectory"** ở đoạn 2 mô tả hướng phát triển/chuyển biến của quy luật đặt tên qua các thế hệ. Do đó, từ này đồng nghĩa với đường hướng/tiến trình phát triển theo thời gian (path of development over time).
  - Với **R4Q6**, từ **"tentative"** ở đoạn 5 mô tả các giải thích hiện tại vẫn chỉ là giả thuyết ban đầu, chưa được khẳng định tuyệt đối. Từ này sát nghĩa nhất với mang tính tạm thời, chưa chắc chắn (provisional and uncertain).
- **Dạng câu hỏi Quy chiếu (R4Q4):** Tìm đại từ **"it"** ở đoạn 4. Áp dụng quy tắc đọc ngược lại câu phía trước: vế trước thảo luận về hiện tượng các gia đình thế hệ thứ ba quay trở lại sử dụng tên gọi truyền thống Khmer cho con cái. Đại từ này quy chiếu trực tiếp đến sự đảo ngược về xu hướng đặt tên truyền thống này.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Chèn câu vào vị trí phù hợp (R4Q8):** Đọc kỹ câu cần chèn: câu này đưa ra phản biện ("Yet each explanation...") rằng các lý thuyết hiện tại chưa giải thích được tại sao sự đảo ngược lại tập trung chủ yếu ở thế hệ thứ ba mà không phải thế hệ thứ hai. Vị trí chèn phù hợp nhất là vị trí **[4]**, ngay sau khi bài viết vừa liệt kê xong các giả thuyết giải thích ở đoạn 5.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Suy luận (R4Q9):** Đọc tổng thể bài viết và chú ý đến đánh giá của tác giả ở đoạn 1 và đoạn cuối. Mặc dù khoảng cách thế hệ có ảnh hưởng, nhưng việc so sánh hai nhóm người nhập cư cho thấy yếu tố thế hệ đơn thuần là không đủ để giải thích nếu không tính đến hoàn cảnh/bối cảnh di cư.
- **Dạng câu hỏi Thái độ của tác giả (R4Q10):** Xem xét đoạn kết của bài viết khi đề cập đến việc mở rộng kết quả nghiên cứu sang các cộng đồng nhập cư khác. Tác giả thể hiện thái độ thận trọng, xem việc áp dụng rộng rãi kết quả này là một câu hỏi mở cần thêm các nghiên cứu thực nghiệm trong tương lai (cautious, open question needing further research).
Lời khuyên: Hãy bắt đầu bài làm bằng việc hoàn thành nhanh nhóm câu hỏi Quy chiếu (R4Q4) và Từ vựng (R4Q2, R4Q6). Tiếp theo, tận dụng kỹ năng đọc quét định vị từ khóa để xử lý các câu hỏi **Chi tiết** (R4Q3, R4Q7), **Loại trừ** (R4Q5) và **Chèn** câu (R4Q8). Sau cùng, xâu chuỗi lập luận logic toàn bài để chọn đáp án chuẩn xác cho các câu tổng hợp bao gồm Suy luận (R4Q9), Thái độ tác giả (R4Q10) và Ý chính toàn bài (R4Q1).

parts.title: A Musical Tribute to the Sailors of the Islands
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: Each year, a handful of cultural programs attempt to bring the lives of soldiers stationed on Vietnam's remote island outposts to audiences who will never set foot there themselves, but few have managed to do so with the emotional reach of a musical program first staged three years ago and now touring several provinces annually. Built around a cycle of original songs rather than a single narrative arc, the program was conceived not as documentary reportage but as an attempt to translate distance and longing into something an urban audience could feel rather than merely learn about secondhand.

The program's musical direction rests largely with composer Dinh Bao, who spent several weeks aboard supply vessels traveling between mainland ports and the outposts before writing a single note. He has said in interviews that the songs were shaped less by what soldiers told him directly than by what he noticed they left unsaid — long pauses before answering questions about home, the way letters were reread until the paper softened. **That reluctance** to narrate their own hardship directly, he has suggested, told him more about the emotional weight of the posting than any complaint could have.

Life at the outposts, as depicted across the program's dozen musical numbers, is defined less by danger in the conventional sense than by the accumulation of small deprivations: fresh vegetables that arrive infrequently, phone signals that vanish for weeks during storm season, birthdays and anniversaries marked alone rather than with family. According to figures cited in the program's accompanying materials, several hundred servicemen currently rotate through these postings at any given time, a number that has stayed relatively steady even as the vessels supplying them have gradually improved. It is this quieter, cumulative form of hardship, rather than any single dramatic event, that the songs return to again and again.

Structurally, the program alternates between full-ensemble numbers depicting collective military routine and quieter solo pieces built around a single soldier's imagined letter home, a device that lets the production shift registers without losing narrative coherence. Between musical numbers, brief spoken interludes performed by actors reading from real letters — with names changed at the families' request — **anchor** the more stylized songs in testimony that audiences can trust as authentic, even where the melodies themselves are entirely invented.

Reception has been notably warmer among audiences who initially expected a straightforwardly patriotic tribute and instead encountered something quieter and more personal; several reviewers have remarked that the program earns its emotional impact precisely by resisting the temptation toward overt sentimentality in its opening numbers, saving its most affecting moments for the second half instead. Ticket demand has grown steadily enough that a fourth touring cycle, extending the program to two additional provinces, is already being planned for next year.

Asked what he most wants audiences to carry away from the program, Dinh Bao has repeatedly returned to a single idea: not sympathy for the soldiers as distant figures deserving pity, but a felt recognition of the ordinary, unglamorous persistence their daily routine actually requires, the sense that endurance itself, sustained quietly over months without applause, is the story worth telling.

questions.type_hint: Định vị thông tin đoạn văn
questions.explanation: Sử dụng kỹ năng Scanning (Đọc quét từ khóa). Tìm cụm từ chỉ số lượng chiến sĩ ("several hundred servicemen"). Số liệu này nằm trực tiếp ở đoạn 3, nơi mô tả những thiếu thốn nhỏ nhặt tích tụ hằng ngày của các quân nhân đang làm nhiệm vụ trên đảo.

questions.stem: The word "That" in paragraph 2 refers to _______.

options.A: the interview format Dinh Bao used with soldiers
options.B: the softened paper of reread letters
options.C: the composer's decision to travel by supply vessel

questions.explanation: Tập trung vào từ chỉ định "That" ở đoạn 2 (trong cụm "That reluctance..."). Đọc lại câu liền trước đó để tìm hành vi được nhắc tới: các chiến sĩ ngập ngừng, dừng lại rất lâu trước khi trả lời về quê nhà, thể hiện sự e ngại / không muốn trực tiếp kể về những gian khổ của bản thân.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT true of the musical program as described in paragraph 1?

options.B: It was conceived as documentary reportage rather than an emotional translation of experience
options.C: It is now touring several provinces annually

questions.explanation: Đối soát các chi tiết mô tả chương trình âm nhạc ở đoạn 1. questions.stem: The word "reluctance" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to _______.

options.B: confusion
options.C: curiosity

questions.stem: According to the passage, what kind of hardship do the program's songs return to most often?

questions.stem: The word "anchor" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to _______.

options.A: confuse
options.B: ground
options.C: replace
options.D: postpone

questions.explanation: từ "anchor" ở đoạn 4 nói về vai trò của các đoạn đọc thư thật giữa các tiết mục âm nhạc: giúp "gắn chặt" hoặc làm chỗ dựa vững chắc (ground) cho các giai điệu nghệ thuật vào thực tế đời sống thật mà khán giả có thể tin tưởng.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about why Dinh Bao paid close attention to what soldiers left unsaid rather than what they told him directly?

options.A: Their silences and habits revealed the posting's true emotional weight.
options.B: Because he was primarily interested in documenting the technical details of outpost life

questions.explanation: Kết hợp thông tin ở đoạn 2. Nhạc sĩ chú ý đến những điều người lính không nói ra vì chính sự im lặng và những khoảng lặng đó lại bộc lộ sức nặng cảm xúc và bản chất công việc chân thực hơn bất kỳ lời phàn nàn trực tiếp nào.

questions.stem: According to the passage, why has audience reception been notably warm?

options.A: Because the program features well-known professional soldiers as its lead performers
options.B: Because ticket prices were lowered to attract a wider range of audiences

- **Dạng câu hỏi Định vị thông tin đoạn văn (R1Q2):** Sử dụng kỹ năng **Scanning** (Đọc quét từ khóa). Tìm cụm từ chỉ số lượng chiến sĩ ("several hundred servicemen"). - **Dạng câu hỏi Quy chiếu (R1Q3):** Tập trung vào từ chỉ định **"That"** ở đoạn 2 (trong cụm "That reluctance..."). parts.title: Charting Vietnam's Path Toward Homegrown AI Talent
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: Conversations about artificial intelligence in Vietnam have, over the past several years, shifted noticeably in tone, moving from a near-exclusive focus on adopting foreign AI tools toward a growing, though still contested, belief that Vietnam might eventually develop AI systems of genuine international significance rather than remaining solely a consumer of technology built elsewhere.

Among the more prominent voices advancing this view is Dean, who leads the Faculty of Information Technology at one of Hanoi's larger technical universities and has, in recent interviews, argued that the country's long-standing strength in mathematics competitions, reflected in consistently strong results at international olympiads over several decades, translates more directly into AI research capability than is commonly assumed, given how heavily modern machine learning depends on exactly the kind of abstract mathematical reasoning those competitions reward.

Huy's confidence rests on more than competition results alone, however. He points to the rapid expansion of domestic programming communities and open-source contributions from Vietnamese developers over the past decade, alongside a marked increase in government funding directed at university AI research labs, as evidence that the underlying talent pipeline is not merely theoretical but is already producing measurable, if still early-stage, output. It is this combination — mathematical foundation, growing practical coding culture, and rising institutional investment — that he cites most often when asked to justify his optimism.

Skeptics within the same academic community are not dismissive of Vietnam's mathematical tradition but argue instead that translating competition mathematics into deployable AI research requires infrastructure, most notably computing power and large curated datasets, that Vietnam still lacks relative to countries where major AI labs are concentrated. Without access to comparable computational resources, these critics contend, even exceptionally talented researchers may find themselves conducting smaller-scale studies rather than the large-model research that currently defines the field's cutting edge.

A separate complication concerns retention rather than raw talent. Vietnamese universities have, for years, produced graduates who go on to build strong reputations at international technology companies, but a persistent pattern of skilled researchers relocating abroad for better-resourced positions has left domestic labs **thinner** than their graduate output alone would suggest. Some industry figures argue that closing this gap depends less on training more talent than on creating research conditions competitive enough to keep **them** in the country once trained.

Huy has acknowledged this retention concern directly but frames it somewhat differently, suggesting that a growing number of overseas-trained Vietnamese researchers are now beginning to return, drawn by newly funded domestic labs and a startup ecosystem that, while still modest by regional standards, has begun offering opportunities that did not exist even five years ago. However, building enough opportunities to fully integrate **them** into these institutions, he concedes, remains genuinely uncertain rather than something he is prepared to guarantee.

What emerges from these overlapping perspectives is less a settled prediction than an open question shaped by competing pressures: strong mathematical foundations and rising investment pulling in one direction, infrastructure gaps and talent retention pulling in the other, with the eventual balance likely to depend on decisions — about funding, infrastructure, and researcher retention — that have not yet been fully made.

parts.title: Reassessing Einstein's Path to Scientific Achievement
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: That Albert Einstein would come to symbolize scientific genius itself is, in one sense, an unlikely outcome given how unremarkable his early academic trajectory actually was; he struggled to secure a university teaching post after graduation, and it was only through a former classmate's father that he obtained a position evaluating patent applications in Bern, a job most historians now agree was less a detour from his scientific development than an unusual accelerant of it. The patent office required him to assess the technical feasibility of proposed inventions quickly and rigorously, a discipline that, several biographers argue, sharpened precisely the kind of conceptual clarity his subsequent physics would demand.

It was during this period, working outside any formal academic research institution, that Einstein produced four papers in 1905 now referred to collectively as his "miracle year" output, though the phrase itself somewhat flattens how differently each paper was received at the time. The paper explaining the photoelectric effect, which proposed that light itself could be understood as discrete packets of energy rather than a continuous wave, was initially met with skepticism even among physicists sympathetic to Einstein's other work, precisely because it challenged the wave theory of light that decades of experimental support had seemingly confirmed.

The special theory of relativity, published the same year, addressed a separate problem entirely: reconciling the behavior of light with the principle that physical laws should hold consistently regardless of an observer's motion. **[1]** Unlike the photoelectric paper, special relativity required no new experimental apparatus to propose, relying instead on thought experiments and mathematical reasoning, **[2] a methodological** difference that some contemporaries found either elegantly minimalist or suspiciously unverifiable, **[3]** depending on their existing **disposition** toward theoretical physics. **[4]**

A full decade passed before Einstein extended these ideas into general relativity, published in 1915, which reframed gravity not as a force acting across space but as a consequence of mass curving space-time itself. The theory's confirmation came only in 1919, when astronomer Arthur Eddington's observations of starlight bending during a solar eclipse matched Einstein's predicted values closely enough to convert much of the remaining scientific skepticism, transforming Einstein almost overnight from a respected physicist into an internationally recognized public figure.

It is a detail frequently misremembered that Einstein's 1921 Nobel Prize was awarded specifically for general relativity; the Nobel committee's citation instead credited his earlier work on the photoelectric effect, a decision that reflected the committee's persistent unease about relativity's still-unresolved experimental status at the time rather than any judgment that the photoelectric paper was his more significant contribution. This distinction, though minor to a casual reader, illustrates how contested even the most celebrated of his ideas remained among specialists years after publication.

Einstein's later career, following his emigration to the United States in 1933 amid rising political persecution in Germany, diverged in a direction not fully anticipated by his earlier scientific output: rather than continuing to produce work with comparable impact, he devoted considerable energy to a decades-long, ultimately unsuccessful search for a unified field theory that would reconcile gravity with electromagnetism, a pursuit several colleagues at the time regarded as increasingly disconnected from where mainstream physics, particularly quantum mechanics, was heading.

His public role during this period extended well beyond physics; he became an outspoken advocate for civil rights and nuclear disarmament, positions that some biographers suggest were shaped as much by his experience of displacement and persecution as by any strictly scientific reasoning, complicating any narrative that treats his later activism as separate from, rather than continuous with, the convictions formed earlier in his life.

Taken together, Einstein's career resists the tidy arc often assigned to it in popular retellings: a supposed steady ascent from obscure patent clerk to celebrated genius understates how contested his early ideas were among peers, how narrowly the 1921 Nobel citation avoided his most famous theory, and how uncertain even his own later research proved relative to the trajectory of physics as a field.

parts.title: The Uncertain Reach of Prisoners' Legal Protections
parts.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
passage: International frameworks governing the treatment of incarcerated people, most notably the United Nations Standard Minimum Rules on the Treatment of Prisoners, commonly known as the Mandela Rules, articulate protections that read, on paper, as comprehensive: prohibitions on torture and prolonged solitary confinement, guarantees of adequate medical care, and requirements for meaningful contact with the outside world. Whether these standards translate into enforceable rights within any given national legal system, however, is a question the framework itself does not resolve, since the Mandela Rules function as non-binding guidance rather than as a treaty carrying direct legal force.

This gap between articulated standard and enforceable right is not uniform across jurisdictions, and it would be a mistake to treat the challenge as identical everywhere it arises. In some legal systems, domestic courts have incorporated the Mandela Rules' language into constitutional protections against cruel and unusual punishment, effectively converting soft guidance into binding precedent through judicial interpretation rather than legislative action. In others, courts have explicitly declined to treat the Rules as creating any judicially enforceable obligation, reasoning that non-binding international guidance cannot, by itself, generate domestic legal rights absent explicit incorporating legislation.

Solitary confinement occupies a particularly contested position within this broader uncertainty. **[1]** A substantial body of psychological research, accumulated over several decades, links prolonged isolation to measurable harm, including heightened rates of anxiety, self-harm, and cognitive impairment, and this evidence has grown difficult for even skeptical courts to dismiss outright. **[2]** Yet the same research rarely specifies a universally applicable threshold at which isolation becomes harmful, since individual variation in tolerance appears considerable. **[3]** This gap is one that some correctional authorities have exploited to argue that any given duration of isolation, however extended, cannot be conclusively presumed harmful in the individual case before the court. [4]

Sentencing reform advocates have, in recent years, increasingly framed prisoners' legal protections not merely as a matter of humane treatment during incarceration but as inseparable from broader questions about sentence length and proportionality, arguing that protections addressing conditions of confinement mean comparatively little if sentences themselves are calibrated with little regard to demonstrated rehabilitation. This framing has proven persuasive to some policymakers, though it has also drawn criticism from those who argue that conflating conditions-based reform with sentencing reform risks diluting political support for either objective by making the overall proposal harder to characterize and defend.

Recidivism data further complicates any straightforward account of what prisoner protections are meant to achieve. Programs emphasizing education and vocational training during incarceration are associated, in several long-term studies, with meaningfully lower reoffending rates after release, a finding that has been used to argue for expanded protections and services on essentially pragmatic, rather than purely humanitarian, grounds. Critics of this framing counter that justifying humane treatment primarily through its effect on recidivism risks implying, perhaps unintentionally, that protections would be less warranted for populations less likely to benefit measurably in those terms, an implication most reform advocates explicitly reject even as they continue to cite the recidivism data strategically.

Legal scholars examining this landscape have increasingly converged on a view that the central obstacle is not an absence of articulated standards, which by most accounts already exist in reasonably comprehensive form, but a persistent enforcement gap between what international and domestic frameworks **nominally** guarantee and what incarcerated individuals can realistically compel through litigation, particularly where courts remain reluctant to second-guess correctional administrators' operational judgments.

This deference to administrative judgment is not applied uniformly, however; several recent domestic rulings have narrowed it specifically in cases involving documented, repeated failures to provide adequate medical care, suggesting that judicial reluctance to intervene may be softening incrementally in particular categories of harm even as it persists broadly elsewhere, a pattern too recent and too unevenly distributed across jurisdictions to characterize confidently as a durable shift rather than a set of isolated exceptions.

options.D: The Mandela Rules function as a binding international treaty that all national courts are legally required to enforce directly
